title: soft towel, UGLY pepto pink elephant logo
text: soft towel, UGLY pepto pink elephant logo. OMG.  I THOUGHT I was buying luxury, soft, heavy WHITE towels.  I was HORRIFIED to open the box and see this SUPER UGLY BRIGHT PEPTO pink elephant on the towels.  Dead to me.  Disappointed just doesn't cover it. There is a single pic of the "logo"... but it looks pale gray - definitely NOT PEPTO pink.  Back in the box and returned.  Unless you're into really sick pepto pink - avoid.  Hopefully they update the photos and make the logo print FRONT AND CENTER.  Gross.
